name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Solve a 0/1 knapsack (values [8, 5, 9, 7
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Solve a 0/1 knapsack (values [8, 5, 9, 7], weights [6, 4, 2, 4], capacity 10) by building a penalized QUBO in dimod (slack-variable encoding for the capacity constraint) and sampling with SimulatedAnnealingSampler. Compare to brute force. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
